I spent more time getting set up before the "no setup for you" drug came out than I did killing either of them.

posts.name: starkenburg_alexander
posts.cooked:
Easy Mint goodness. I spent way longer than was really necessary getting setup on Spite. Between Hypersonic Assault and Naturalist tanking with Indomitable Rhino Hide, I was taking no damage most rounds. Legacy healed with Motivational and bouncing Inspiring Presence, then Tempest got out Downpour. 

I decided it was time to end Spite and went on a Stuntman Blitz. Spite dropped, and Gloomweaver followed soon after due to the massive amount of setup I had done. I could have healed back up to a perfect game if I had wanted to, but everyone near 20hp was good enough :)

Only issue I had was trying to set up Lightspeed Barrages on Tachyon against Spite. Between discarding on power usage and drawing extra cards from the Sidekick, I kept shuffling the trash before I was ready. 

~Komori

Pretty similar to Komori above, I noticed Naturalist could start mega-tanking right away and did so. Putzed around against Spite getting as set up as I wanted to while chipping away at him, then ended him on Tempest's turn while Legacy had Take Down in play and Tachyon had a couple of Synaptic Interruptions out. Gloomweaver came in, couldn't play a card, whiffed at Tachyon, then we got two full rounds of unloading on him because I dropped In Medias Res during the environment turn.

He did not survive those two rounds. Mint at full HP.

posts.name: QuirkyDM
posts.cooked:
Also an easy mint for me and I also had the Naturalist bug after Gloomweaver came in.

Naturalist tanked from turn 1 and never looked back, absorbing all damage for the rest of the game. Legacy used his base power to give Naturalist a power use so he would have all animal forms available every turn, but it was not necessary. Moving Target on Stuntman meant he got to use all his powers on both Spite's turn and on Stuntman's turn. I should have sent Legacy's power use over to Stuntman once Moving Target came out. Tempest put out Genetic Shackles, Local Hurricane and Vicious Cyclone to do lots of damage himself. Shielding Winds also came out to really make Naturalist invulnerable.

When Gloomweaver came out, Stuntman used Ambuscade to play In Media Res and Gloomweaver's first turn got skipped. Legacy played Takedown on the first turn. During Gloomweaver's actual first turn, Stuntman's Moving Target flipped Gloomweaver over and destroyed the Pouch of Bones. Tachyon had three fully charged Light Speed Barrages saved up and Gloomweaver came out of the ground only to be pounded back without a chance to do anything.
